governing_equation_decision.exact_equation: i partial_t psi = -(1/2) partial_xx psi + kappa (|psi|^2-1) psi
governing_equation_decision.why_new_instead_of_source_adoption: The source supplies the structural equation but not a complete nondimensionalization, parameter range, initial-data class, failure contract, or authoritative resolution of the three-record conflict. CCFT-v0 therefore adopts the CP_EQ_002 structure while declaring the exact normalized model as a new postulate rather than a recovered final equation.
governing_equation_decision.selection_rationale: This is the unique minimal cubic option among the frozen records: it uses one complex state and one nonnegative interaction control, is meaningful on the recovered periodic domain, recovers the shared linear control at kappa=0, and yields an exact upstream dispersion question without fourth- or sixth-derivative additions.
governing_equation_decision.quick_rejection_route: Reject or weaken the v0 route if later work proves ill-posedness in the frozen data class, refutes its candidate invariant without a replacement, or shows that its only content is gauge-equivalent to a generic known nonlinear Schrodinger model.
governing_equation_decision.director_consequence: The project is constructing a testable cubic periodic surrogate, not declaring that the archive selected the final CCFT equation.
